name: Souper Cubes Cotton Candy One-Cup Freezer Tray

image.alt: Pink Souper Cubes freezer tray with multicolored flecks, four rectangular wells in a row, and a clear lid.

cardLine: One-cup soup portions, with a sprinkle-flecked twist.
description: This reusable silicone freezer tray portions soup into one-cup servings beneath a removable lid. The Cotton Candy version pairs pink silicone with multicolored, sprinkle-like flecks, a distinctive detail for a soup-season batch-cooking routine.
whyWePicked: The sprinkle-flecked finish brings an unexpected visual detail to the practical routine of portioning soup.
